title: Finance Manager - AI Native (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

 

💡 YOUR MISSION: BUILD THE FINANCIAL ENGINE FOR OUR NEXT STAGE OF GROWTH

As an AI-Native Finance Manager, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally.

This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering. You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions.

At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function. You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them - someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better.

 

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize.

- Drive financial reporting and analysis, building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions.

- Own and improve operational finance processes, including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation.

- Build and improve our Finance stack, connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work.

- Support our international growth, working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations.

 

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role, with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience.

- Strong analytical and commercial thinking, with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations.

- A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable.

- Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently.

title: Customer service manager (PL)
description:
ParcelHero is one of the UK's biggest parcel delivery price comparison sites, with over 5 million visitors a year. We're a scaling, technology-focused business with 120 remote staff worldwide - and we're growing fast, expanding internationally into the US and Europe this year.

We serve both consumers and businesses in an almost 50/50 split, and our move into SaaS is shifting that mix further towards larger businesses and, ultimately, enterprise customers. In 2026, we launched our cutting-edge TMS (Transport Management Solution), Parcelhero Pro, enabling retailers to pay a monthly subscription to ship on their own carrier accounts and manage every aspect of their logistics through our platform.

We're a highly innovative company, deeply focused on optimisation, automation, and continuous process improvement. Joining now means being part of the journey - helping shape our technology, our processes, and our approach as we scale globally.

We're also a remote-first business: no commute, no office politics, just great work with talented colleagues around the world.

Job description
Are you passionate about improving the customer experience? Does coordinating across teams, countries, and time zones excite you? Parcelhero is looking for an experienced Customer Service Manager to lead our team leaders and 50-strong remote team, drive quality of service, and elevate the experience for both our consumer and business customers as we expand internationally.
This is a high-pace, high-pressure environment. You'll need to be decisive, sharp, and comfortable making fast, sound judgement calls while managing competing priorities across departments and time zones. As our customer base shifts towards larger business and enterprise customers, you'll help evolve our service to meet their expectations.
You will be responsible for driving cross-department collaboration between the customer service, customer experience, and QA teams - working closely with them to optimise processes and continuously improve the customer experience as we scale.
Responsibilities

Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of team leaders overseeing a 50-strong remote customer service team, setting clear performance expectations and fostering high performance under pressure.

Cross- Department Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Experience and QA teams on customer journey optimisation, process improvement, and automation initiatives - ensuring the customer service team's insights and frontline experience feed directly into these efforts.

Customer Feedback Management: Collect and analyse customer feedback (e.g., surveys, reviews) alongside the Customer Experience team to identify pain points and opportunities to enhance the overall experience.

Service Quality and Metrics: Track and improve key service metrics, such as Net Promoter Score (NPS), customer satisfaction, and customer effort score, driving quality of service across the team.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with marketing, product, and technology teams to ensure all customer touchpoints (website, booking platform, support) align with customer needs and expectations.

Custom er Communication Strategy: Develop communication strategies to improve how customers are informed about delivery updates, service disruptions, and issue resolutions.

Service Innovation: Identify opportunities to introduce new services, tools, or processes that enhance the customer experience, working with the relevant teams to bring them to life.

Customer Education: Support initiatives to provide customers with educational content (e.g., how-to guides, FAQs) to improve self-service options and reduce the need for support.

Vendor Relationship Management: Liaise with courier partners (DHL, FedEx, UPS) to ensure they provide services that meet or exceed customer expectations.

Applicant criteria

• A minimum of 10 years' customer service experience.

title: Server Specialist
description:
Role Profile - Server Specialist
Job Summary
The Server Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining server infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability. This role involves managing physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and related technologies, while providing technical expertise and support to internal teams.
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, and maintain Windows/Linux servers and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

• Monitor server performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement corrective actions.

• Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.

• Perform regular backups and disaster recovery planning.

• Apply security patches and updates to maintain compliance.

• Collaborate with network and application teams for system integration.

• Document configurations, processes, and troubleshooting steps.

• Provide Tier 2/3 support for server-related incidents.

• Plan and execute server migrations and upgrades.

• Implement and maintain high-availability and failover solutions.

• Monitor and optimize resource utilization across servers and storage.

• Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and industry standards.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts for routine tasks (PowerShell, Bash).

• Participate in capacity planning and forecasting for server infrastructure.

• Assist in cloud integration and hybrid environment management (Azure/AWS).

• Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and remediation.

• Train and mentor junior IT staff on server technologies and best practices.

• Prepare reports on server health, performance, and utilization for management.

Required Knowledge

• Operating Systems: Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Red Hat).

• Virtualization: VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V.

• Storage: SAN/NAS technologies, RAID configurations.

• Networking Basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls.

• Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS (preferred).

• Security: Server hardening, patch management, antivirus solutions.

• Backup & Recovery: Veeam, Commvault, or similar tools.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in server administration.

• Experience in managing enterprise-level infrastructure.

• Proven track record in troubleshooting complex server issues.

• Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem management).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Bash) for automation.

• Team-oriented with the ability to work independently.

• Certifications (Preferred)

• Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.

• VMware Certified Professional (VCP).

• CompTIA Server+ or equivalent.

description:

Job Overview:

As FP&A Manager, you’ll own the financial models, forecasts, and reporting that show leadership and our board how the business is performing and where it’s headed. You’ll build and maintain our Cash EBITDA, free cash flow, and recurring-revenue models, lead the Annual Operating Plan and forecast cycles, and turn results into clear, actionable insight. • Reconcile ARR and bookings data from Salesforce to the general ledger and recognized revenue, partnering with Accounting and RevOps to resolve discrepancies at the source.

• Opportunities for professional development and growth.

title: Expert Financial Performance & Value Creation (m/w/d)
description:
DIE CHANCE

Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen aus dem Bestand und durch Übernahmen. Beides stellt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich, und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate.

Die Rolle ist auf ein bis drei Jahre Beratungserfahrung zugeschnitten. Du treibst die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her. Du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können, auch wenn das Gespräch unangenehm wird. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest an Moritz Bonacker.

WAS DU VERANTWORTEST

Ertragskraft und Produktivität

- Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens, von der Mandatsgröße bis zum Deckungsbeitrag, und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird.

- Bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht.

- Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum.

Durchsetzung

- Führ die Honorargespräche selbst oder mit einem Berufsträger an deiner Seite. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität.

- Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen: was ihre Mandate und Teams produzieren, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, was sich konkret ändern muss.

- Verfolge die Maßnahmen nach, bis das Ergebnis in den Zahlen steht. Auch wenn es unbequem wird.

Zukauf und Vorausschau

- Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite und verfolge ihn über Jahre statt über hundert Tage. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast.

- Verantworte Umsatz- und Ergebnisprognose, Budgets, Szenarien und Abweichungsanalysen über alle Standorte, auch die neu dazugekommenen.

- Automatisiere, was du baust. Keine Auswertung, die jemand monatlich manuell zusammensetzt.

FRAGEN, AUF DIE DU DIE ANTWORT FINDEST

- Ein Mandat trägt seinen Deckungsbeitrag nicht, die Beziehung besteht seit fünfzehn Jahren: Wie gehst du in dieses Gespräch, und wo ist deine Grenze?

- Woran unterscheidest du eine Leistung, die zu billig ist, von einer, die zu aufwendig erbracht wird?

- Deine Empfehlung wird von jemandem blockiert, der dir nicht berichtet. Was tust du, wenn das zweite Gespräch auch nichts bringt?

WORAN WIR ERFOLG MESSEN

- Nach 6 Monaten: Der erste Bestand ist vollständig durchgerechnet, Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat und Leistungsart liegen belastbar vor, die erste Auswertung läuft automatisiert, die ersten Honorargespräche hast du selbst geführt.

- Nach 12 Monaten: Die erste Anpassungswelle ist über den Bestand gefahren, das erreichte Honorarniveau nachgewiesen. Die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung wird in Führungsentscheidungen verwendet. Deine Prognose trägt, ihre Abweichung kannst du erklären.

- Nach 24 Monaten: Mehrere Übernahmen begleitet, die spätere lief nachweislich besser als die erste. Die Steuerung läuft weitgehend automatisiert, dein Anteil hat sich von der Aufbereitung zur Interpretation verschoben.

- Wohin es führt: in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn, mit größerem Themenfeld und mehr methodischer Autorität. Willst du ein Team aufbauen, steht dir die Führungslaufbahn ebenso offen. Entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Du hast ein bis drei Jahre in der Beratung gearbeitet,

title: Business Development Manager
description:

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Our Business Development Reps (BDRs) are the first people new brands meet at ShopMy. They find brands that fit, start the conversation, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. That net-new pipeline is where most of our new revenue starts.

The BDR team is scaling quickly, and we're hiring a Business Development Manager to help lead it. You'll own a pod of BDRs, coach them day to day, hit your team's meeting and pipeline goals, and build the systems that let the team keep growing. You'll work closely with our AEs, RevOps and Enablement teams.

This is a player-coach role. You should be able to jump on a call, rewrite an email, or build a target list alongside your reps, then turn what works into something the whole team can use.

What you'll do

Lead and coach your team

• Manage a pod of BDRs with weekly 1:1s, clear goals and direct feedback

• Review outreach with reps and coach them in the moment on messaging, objection handling and booking meetings

• Spot who's struggling early and build a plan with them to get back on track

• Develop reps into their next role, whether that's AE or another cross-functional role

• Help interview and hire new BDRs as the team grows

Own the number

• Own your team's monthly and quarterly goals for meetings booked and qualified pipeline

• Track activity, reply rates, meetings held and meeting-to-opportunity conversion, and act fast when something slips

• Partner with the Brand Growth team on which brands and segments each rep should target

Build how the team works

• Create and refine outreach playbooks, email templates, account trackers and prioritization strategies

• Onboard new BDRs so they ramp faster

• Work with Enablement on training, and bring what's working in the field back to them

• Keep Salesforce clean so everyone can trust the pipeline numbers

Work across teams

• Partner with AE managers so meetings are handed off smoothly and AEs get the context they need

• Share feedback from the field with Marketing, Product and RevOps

• Report on team results and trends to sales leadership

Who you are

• 2+ years as a people manager of BDRs or SDRs (formal management, not team lead)

• 4+ years in B2B sales, including time as a top-performing BDR yourself

• You've owned a team's meetings or pipeline quota and consistently hit or exceeded it

• You coach by doing. You're comfortable leading strategy sessions, rewriting outreach and showing a rep what good looks like.

• You're comfortable with numbers and can use Salesforce reports to see where the team is winning and where it's stuck

• A clear, direct communicator who gives honest feedback in a way that helps people grow

• Organized and able to keep a fast-moving team on track without losing sight of each rep

• You like building. You're happy in a fast-growing startup where the playbook is still being written

• Team-first, low ego and excited to help other people succeed

Bonus points

• Experience leading BDRs in an SMB or mid-market motion

• Experience selling

title: Senior Clinical Informaticist
description:
About Mosai

Mosai ™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai , home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​
Position Summary
Mosai is looking for a Senior Clinical Informaticist to be the clinical conscience of its AI and help drive AI-assisted health care at home. Working with data scientists and ML engineers, this person will own the clinical ground truth used to train and evaluate models, including what gets labeled, how it gets labeled, and whether outputs are safe and correct for nurses, therapists, and hospice teams to use.
As the first hire in the clinical informatics function, this hands-on senior leader will create annotation guidelines, label and adjudicate data, build gold-standard datasets, and lead clinical evaluation of models and LLM-based features. The role brings knowledge of how care is delivered and documented at home into the data and logic used by Mosai 's AI, while helping build the clinical informatics team.
Job Duties:

• Own clinical annotation: design labeling schemas and versioned guidelines for clinical notes, OASIS items, diagnoses, medications, wounds, functional status, and other home health and hospice concepts.

• Label and adjudicate data directly; engage appropriate in-house clinical resources, resolve annotator disagreements, make final clinical calls on edge cases, and build and maintain core gold-standard datasets for data science models.

• Work with MLOps and data science teams to report and monitor model performance and respond to drift in key accuracy metrics.

• Measure inter-annotator agreement using standard metrics, such as Cohen's or Fleiss' kappa; run calibration sessions, audit samples, and improve annotation guidelines and workflows.

• Evaluate model predictions and LLM-generated text for accuracy, completeness, hallucination, bias, and clinical safety.

• Design evaluation rubrics and help define clinical criteria for release of traditional ML and LLM-based models.

• Translate home health and hospice workflows, including start of care, recertification, resumption of care, discharge, hospice admission, and IDG, into structured data, rules, and features.

• Map clinical concepts to ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OASIS, and hospice HOPE data elements; support EHR integration, including HomeCare HomeBase, using HL7 and FHIR.

• Define clinical data quality checks, document provenance and dataset versions, and apply HIPAA, minimum-necessary, and de-identification practices to labeling work.

• Support development of AI capabilities by demonstrating how skilled clinicians perform the same tasks.

• Partner with product and engineering on clinical requirements, pre-release validation, post-release model monitoring, and clinician feedback loops.

• Recruit, train, and mentor clinical annotators and junior informaticists as the program grows.

Minimum Requirements

• Active, unrestricted clinical license as an RN (BSN or equivalent), Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, or Speech-Language Pathologist.

• At least five years of clinical experience, including meaningful time in home health and/or hospice.

• At least four years in clinical informatics, such as informatics nursing, clinical analysis, clinical data abstraction, or quality, aligned with recognized standards such as the ANA Nursing Informatics Scope and Standards of Practice or AMIA health informatics core competencies.

• Core informatics competencies in clinical workflow analysis, data governance and quality, the system lifecycle (requirements, testing, validation, and go-live), and clinical decision support or quality measure logi

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle ’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .
What you’ll be part of:
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
About the role
As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.

As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.

What you’ll do

• Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.

• Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.

• Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.

• Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.

• Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.

• Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.

• Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle ’s fraud platform.

• Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

• 5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime

• Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar

• Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag

• Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization

• Experience taking models to production and monitoring them

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners

• Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

• Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes

• Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data

• Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC

• Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows

As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. title: Clinical Affairs Lead
description:
We are hiring a Clinical Affairs Lead who knows clinical evaluation under MDR inside out, and who wants to bring that expertise in-house at a fast-growing AI company in healthcare.

Our Mission
Healthcare is facing a quiet crisis: doctors and nurses are spending more time fighting with keyboards than treating patients. At Attendi, we’re building a medical AI copilot to give them their time back. Our tools handle the heavy clinical documentation - from live ambient transcription to structured report writing - so doctors can look at their patients, not their screens.
With an aging population, the pressure on healthcare is scaling faster than the workforce. We believe intelligent technology should step up and carry the administrative weight, and we need team members who want to build systems that solve real-world human burnout.

Your Role
As Clinical Affairs Lead at Attendi, you will:

• Own the clinical evaluation of the Attendi App: literature searches, clinical evaluation plans and reports (CEP/CER).

• Translate our MDR roadmap into concrete research questions, study protocols and evidence strategies.

• Design and run studies, from surveys and usability-related studies to clinical investigations and PMCF activities, including preparing submissions for ethical review.

• Help define how we collect data in the app, so we can gather clinical evidence efficiently.

• Analyse study data and statistics and write clear, well-founded reports.

• Work closely with our Clinical Product Owner, compliance team and product team.

• Be a point of contact for our notified body on clinical topics.

• Work with care organisations and external partners when setting up studies.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• A university master’s degree, for example in health sciences or Technical Medicine. A PhD is a plus.

• 3 to 6 years of experience in clinical affairs at a medtech, digital health, CRO or notified body.

• Hands-on MDR experience: you have written a CER under MDR, carried out a clinical investigation or PMCF study including ethical review, and worked directly with a notified body.

• You know how to balance extensive research with a pragmatic approach.

• You can translate complex standards and regulations into what’s concretely needed for a study or report.

• You’re comfortable moving forward with 80% of the input, without losing accuracy.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Strong candidates may also

• Have experience with Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or AI.

• Be familiar with nursing classifications such as Omaha or NANDA.

• Have experience in elderly care or disability care.

• Have worked at a smaller MDR-certified company, where you were close to the product.

• Have a background in study design or biostatistics.

What we offer

• Salary between €4,500 and €6,000 per month, plus holiday allowance.

• Ideally 32h per week.

• Hybrid working: 50/50 office and working from home.

• Travel and lunch allowance.

• Home office budget.

• Lease bike.

• Training budget of €1,500 per year.

• Company MacBook.

• ClassPass membership.

• Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

• Intro call with Roundr, our embedded recruitment partner

• Interview with our Compliance Officer and one of our founders

• Case Round at our office with our Clinical Product Owner and one of our founders

• Offer, reference and pre-boarding!

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. BIG PICTURE:
We’re looking for an Assistant Editor who keeps our post-production pipeline organized and moving. You’ll collate and prep project files for our VFX and color teams, and manage the digital assets behind every episode we produce.
This is a hands-on support role. You’ll make sure editors, VFX artists, and colorists get clean, complete, correctly structured files on time, and that every piece of footage, project file, and finished master is ingested, organized, backed up, and archived.
Why this role matters
We deliver several hours of original content every week. Missing media, broken links, or poorly prepped turnovers cost our VFX and color teams hours they don’t have.
A well-run library, with clear naming, accurate metadata, and reliable archives, means faster turnarounds, easy re-versioning, and no lost work. You’ll be the person who makes handoffs between editorial, VFX, and color seamless.
HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:
Assistant editorial: file collation and handoffs

• Collating all project files, media, graphics, music, and SFX for each episode into a complete, correctly structured package

• Organizing project bins, sequences, and timelines so editors can pick up work without delays

VFX prep

• Preparing VFX turnovers: exporting plates with handles, reference clips, and EDL/XML files to spec

• Naming and numbering VFX shots consistently and logging them in the VFX tracker

• Packaging shot notes, reference frames, and editor instructions with each turnover

• Bringing returned VFX shots back into the timeline and checking them for sync, frame accuracy, and version

Color prep

• Preparing locked cuts for color: simplifying timelines, flattening tracks, and removing unsupported effects

• Exporting XML/AAF/EDL files and reference videos for the colorist

• Confirming all source media is linked and accessible for the grade

• Conforming and patching graded media back into the edit, then QC’ing against the reference

Digital asset management

• Ingesting and verifying camera footage, audio, graphics, and music using checksum-verified offloads

• Maintaining folder structures, file-naming conventions, and version control across raw footage, projects, and deliverables

• Logging and tagging assets with accurate, searchable metadata (series, episode, talent, shoot date, usage rights)

• Uploading all working files and backups to the server in the agreed path, so any editor can pick up a project

• Creating proxies, transcodes, and alternate versions (textless, clean, localized) as needed

• Exporting and QC’ing final masters to spec (resolution, codec, aspect ratio, captions, loudness)

• Archiving completed projects to long-term cloud and offline storage, and retrieving archived media on request

• Monitoring storage capacity and keeping drives and servers clean per retention guidelines

• Strong RAG engineering across vector DBs, chunking/embedding strategies, metadata/search ranking, and grounding techniques.

• Proven track record building observable, cost-aware, and secure LLM systems (tracing, evals, guardrails, secrets/IAM, PII handling).

• Solid software engineering fundamentals: Python/TypeScript, async patterns, APIs, testing, CI/CD, containerization.

• Clear communicator who can interface with clients and write crisp technical docs.

Nice to have

• Cross-cloud exposure (AWS/GCP) and hybrid integrations; experience with ent

title: Account Executive - AI Native, EMEA
description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget.

You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product.

The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are negotiating terms with a CEO.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own a book of AI-native accounts and close new business quickly, often moving from first call to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters.

- Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one.

- Get hands-on in technical conversations: scope workloads, set up quick proofs of concept, and show customers how Modal fits into their stack.

- Spot expansion early and help fast-growing customers scale their inference, training, and sandbox workloads as their usage takes off.

- Help build and engage Modal’s developer community through events, meetups, open-source channels, and word of mouth.

- Bring sharp, structured customer feedback to our product and engineering teams to shape the roadmap.

- Help define how Modal sells to AI-native companies, including the playbooks, pricing motions, and processes we’ll scale as the team grows.

REQUIREMENTS:

- An engineering background, followed by time as a solutions architect, sales engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role, and now experience as a closing seller.

- Current or recent experience at an AI-native company, ideally selling infrastructure, ML/AI, or developer tools.

- A track record of selling directly to founders and technical leaders and closing deals quickly in a high-velocity sales cycle.

- Experience building or engaging a developer community, or a clear point of view on how community drives pipeline.

- Enough technical depth to go deep on GPUs, inference, containers, and model training with engineers, without needing a sales engineer in the room.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

- Comfort in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and excitement about building processes from the ground up.

The ASC Solutions Architect is the commercial solutioning and deal-architecture lead for complex ambulatory surgery center opportunities. This role partners with ASC Development Leaders, regional and account sales teams, product specialists, finance, Healthcare Financial Services, service, legal, compliance, operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer requirements into coordinated, customer-centered, financially sound, and executable multi-modality solutions. The Solutions Architect owns the development of integrated equipment and service bundles, configurations, quotes, financing pathways, deal economics, approval materials, and commercial execution plans while supporting a consistent experience from discovery through booked order and implementation handoff. Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Solution Design and Configuration

• Partner with the ASC Development Leader and commercial teams to translate the customer’s clinical strategy, procedure mix, facility plan, workflow, timeline, budget, and growth objectives into a coordinated solution architecture.

• Design scalable ASC bundles across relevant GE HealthCare equipment, software, digital, service, training, and partner capabilities, balancing customer requirements, clinical workflow, standardization, implementation readiness, and commercial objectives.

• Coordinate modality inputs, technical requirements, room and infrastructure assumptions, product dependencies, compatibility considerations, and configuration decisions. Document open items, owners, risks, and required decisions.

• Develop repeatable standard configurations and modular ASC offerings that can be adapted to independent, health system, MSO, private equity, and joint-venture customer models.

Commercial and Financial Solutioning

• Build and evaluate deal economics, including equipment and service scope, pricing, margin, customer value, projected savings, financing structure, cash-flow considerations, revenue recognition inputs, risk, and expected commercial outcomes.

• Partner with Finance and Healthcare Financial Services to evaluate capital purchase, lease, financing, phased deployment, and other approved commercial structures that align with the customer’s capital strategy and GE HealthCare requirements.

• Perform horizontal pricing analysis across modalities and offerings, identify tradeoffs, and develop recommendations that improve competitiveness while maintaining pricing discipline, compliance, and profitability.

• Prepare clear financial models, scenario comparisons, approval summaries, and executive-level decision materials that simplify complex data and enable timely action.

Quoting, Governance, and Approvals

• Engage required stakeholders early and facilitate pricing, risk, legal, compliance, contracting, finance, and Delegation of Authority reviews. Track approvals and resolve gaps or escalations.

• Maintain strong process discipline in CRM, quoting tools, opportunity documentation, version control, assumptions, milestones, and handoffs.

• Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable company policies, pricing governance, commercial approval requirements, contracting standards, and customer commitments.

Pursuit and Cross-Functional Execution

• Serve as the solution-development partner to the ASC Development Leader, who remains the opportunity quarterback and owner of market development, executive relationships, opportunity strategy, pipeline, forecast, and commercial outcomes.

LA MAISON

Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de la Maison, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Assistant(e) en VISUAL DESIGN CREAT
